title: FortKnight meal-plan document
description: The fortnight menu a person (or their assistant) hands to FortKnight: for each meal, the dishes and the day(s) they are eaten — a second day means the first day's leftovers. Applied on the ForkKnife page (or the Assistant page) into the profile's answers (docs/meal-plan.md). Meals are named as in the questionnaire (Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner…); days are FortKnight day keys (sun-a … sat-b) or their names (Sunday A). Rules: a second serving is never the next day and at most three days later, cyclic (Saturday B → Monday B); one dish per meal per day; leftovers may move to another meal (leftoversMeal) from an afternoon/evening/late-evening meal to an early-morning/mid-morning/afternoon meal.

meal.description: The meal's name (as in the questionnaire) — matched by slug.

days.description: First serving, then optionally the leftovers day: day keys (sun-a) or names (Sunday A).

leftoversMeal.description: Optional: the meal that eats the leftovers when it is not the same meal — allowed from an afternoon/evening/late-evening meal to an early-morning/mid-morning/afternoon meal (dinner Sunday A -> breakfast Tuesday A).

needsPrepped.description: This dish's own answer, overriding its meal: false = no prepping needed for this dish (no Prep task), true = as the meal says. Absent or null follows the meal (docs/meal-plan.md).

needsCooked.description: This dish's own answer, overriding its meal: false = no cooking needed for this dish (no Cook task), true = as the meal says. Absent or null follows the meal (docs/meal-plan.md).
